name: vita-savemgr
description: Dump / Restore for PSVita game save
long_description: 1. Install vpk 2. Launch savemgr in Home shell 3. Select game 4. Wait 3sec, will auto launch dumper 5. Dump or Restore game save. 6. Exit with X (DO NOT FORCE CLOSE) 7. Auto relaunch savemgr, then cleanup injected things. 8. Repeat 3~7 steps or close savemgr 9. Play game.
